The main takeaway from our work is that
the epidemiology of CNDDs may be driven by specific protein or protein combinations that are not entity-specific.

there is an emerging pattern of drivers that can be detected in the clinical epidemiology of NDDs, and that these drivers can be used as footprints to identify specific proteins or protein combinations that may play a role in the pathogenesis of NDDs.
, if confirmed, the pattern would suggest that the pathogenesis of NDDs is not entity-specific, and that it might be driven by a few, common, biological processes.
